description.value: Mt. Washington Guesthouse is a self-catering vacation rental property managed by Cona Vacation Getaways, a family-run boutique company operating multiple chalets and lodges near Mount Washington Alpine Resort on Vancouver Island. The company was founded by two avid outdoor enthusiasts with a background in eco-tourism and began as a backpacker's hostel in Courtenay before expanding into vacation rental management. The Mount Washington area offers both alpine and Nordic terrain and is a destination for mountain biking, making this rental a possible base for cycle-touring or trail riders.
